# Master Documentation Consistency Review

**Epic:** D0.4  
**Milestone:** v0.8-data-foundation  
**Inputs reviewed:**

- `docs/project/documentation-inventory.md`
- `docs/project/canonical-documentation-structure.md`
- `docs/project/master-document-specification.md`

**Scope:** Documentation review only. No master documents are generated by this
review.

## Final Decision

**READY** for MASTER document generation.

The proposed Master Documentation System is internally consistent enough to
generate permanent master documents. One non-blocking inconsistency was found:
D0.2's proposed future tree omitted `MASTER_ENGINEERING.md`, while D0.3
correctly includes it in the five-document master set. Treat D0.3 as the newer
authority when creating the master docs.

## Consistency Report

| Check | Result | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ownership conflicts | PASS with one note | Each master has one primary owner. Adjunct docs also have one owner each. |
| Duplicated responsibilities | PASS | Product, architecture, engineering, roadmap, and plan responsibilities are separated. |
| Missing ownership | PASS | Owner categories cover product/strategy, architecture, engineering, data, research/evidence, automation, and release. |
| Cyclic dependencies | PASS | Conceptual references exist between masters, but update order prevents circular authorship. |
| Ambiguous document boundaries | PASS | D0.3 clearly separates master docs from adjunct status/gate docs. |
| Update-order conflicts | PASS | Sprint/domain evidence updates precede master updates. |
| Review-order conflicts | PASS | Review order begins with scope and no-implementation checks before canonical status. |
| AI reading-order conflicts | PASS | ChatGPT, Codex, engineers, reviewers, and release managers have distinct read paths. |
| Sprint ownership conflicts | PASS | Sprint docs remain evidence records and are not owned by master docs. |
| Engineering-rule ownership conflicts | PASS | `MASTER_ENGINEERING` owns process, while `AGENTS.md` and `.skills/quantterminal-rules.md` remain required operational instructions. |

## Issues

| ID | Problem | Impact | Recommendation | Severity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| D0.4-01 | `canonical-documentation-structure.md` proposes a future `docs/master/` tree containing `MASTER_PLAN`, `MASTER_ARCHITECTURE`, `MASTER_PRODUCT`, and `MASTER_ROADMAP`, but omits `MASTER_ENGINEERING`. | Future file-movement work could accidentally create a four-master tree while the accepted specification requires five masters. | When generating or moving master docs, include `MASTER_ENGINEERING.md` in the master set. D0.3 should be treated as superseding D0.2 on this point. | LOW |
| D0.4-02 | D0.2 places adjuncts (`DATA_FOUNDATION_STATUS`, `AUTOMATION_ENTRY_CRITERIA`, `REASONING_ENTRY_CRITERIA`) under `docs/master/`, while D0.3 says they are adjuncts, not master documents. | Naming/location could confuse readers into treating status/gate docs as master docs. | Keep adjuncts near masters if useful, but label them as adjunct operational documents. Prefer `docs/master/adjunct/` or `docs/status/` during future file movement. | LOW |

No blocking issue was found.

## No Two-Master Requirement Validation

No existing canonical document requires two masters.

Documents with cross-cutting value are assigned one primary master and may be
referenced by others:

| Document / group | Primary master | Why no second master is required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `phase5-final-certification.md` | `MASTER_PLAN` | It freezes the milestone; architecture and roadmap can reference it without owning it. |
| `evidence-packet-engine.md` | `MASTER_ARCHITECTURE` | Product can describe evidence-card UX, but Evidence Packet ownership is architectural. |
| `repository-replay-mode.md` | `MASTER_ARCHITECTURE` | Product owns Replay experience; architecture owns repository-backed data path. |
| `data-source-governance.md` | `MASTER_ARCHITECTURE` | Engineering can enforce validation, but source ownership is architectural/dataflow. |
| `AGENTS.md` / `.skills/quantterminal-rules.md` | `MASTER_ENGINEERING` | They remain operational instructions; master engineering summarizes and references them. |
| Page state docs | `MASTER_PRODUCT` | Architecture only references presentation boundaries; product owns page behavior. |

## Dependency Validation

The master dependency graph is acceptable if interpreted as reading/reference
order rather than authoring order.

| Dependency | Validation |
| --- | --- |
| `MASTER_PLAN -> MASTER_ARCHITECTURE` | PASS; plan references architecture for implementation boundaries. |
| `MASTER_PLAN -> MASTER_PRODUCT` | PASS; plan references product for UX detail. |
| `MASTER_ARCHITECTURE -> MASTER_PLAN` | PASS as principle reference only; not an update cycle. |
| `MASTER_ARCHITECTURE -> MASTER_ENGINEERING` | PASS; architecture references workflow, not vice versa ownership. |
| `MASTER_ROADMAP -> MASTER_PLAN` | PASS; roadmap derives direction from plan. |
| `MASTER_ROADMAP -> MASTER_ARCHITECTURE` | PASS; roadmap respects dependency constraints. |
| `MASTER_ROADMAP -> MASTER_ENGINEERING` | PASS; roadmap respects workflow gates. |

No cyclic update conflict exists because D0.3 defines update order:

```text
Sprint or audit document
-> Domain entry document
-> Adjunct status/gate document
-> Relevant master document
-> MASTER_ROADMAP if sequencing changed
-> Documentation inventory only during audit sprint
```

## Engineering Rule Ownership Validation

`MASTER_ENGINEERING` owns durable engineering policy, but it must not override
the active operational instructions in:

- `AGENTS.md`
- `.skills/quantterminal-rules.md`

Validation result: PASS.

Required rule:

```text
If MASTER_ENGINEERING conflicts with AGENTS.md or active skill rules,
AGENTS.md / active skill rules win until the conflict is resolved in a
documentation governance sprint.
```

This rule should be included when `MASTER_ENGINEERING.md` is generated.

| Architecture vs Product | PASS | Architecture owns dataflow; Product owns presentation/UX. |

| Adjuncts vs Masters | PASS with note | Adjuncts should be clearly labeled operational, not master docs. |

## Final Readiness

**READY.**

Master document generation may begin with the following conditions:

1. Generate all five masters, including `MASTER_ENGINEERING.md`.
2. Treat `DATA_FOUNDATION_STATUS`, `AUTOMATION_ENTRY_CRITERIA`, and
   `REASONING_ENTRY_CRITERIA` as adjuncts, not masters.
3. Include the engineering-rule precedence statement in `MASTER_ENGINEERING.md`.
4. Do not move, delete, or archive existing files during master generation.
5. Link master summaries back to source sprint/certification documents.

The Master Documentation System is internally consistent.
